language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Courier kata tak jumpa rumah saya tapi navigation jelas!

language_layer.source_text_zh: 收到的东西坏了，包装都破了！
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Barang yg dpt rosak, box pecah!
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Barang yang dapat rosak, box pecah!

language_layer.source_text_zh: 快递员态度很差，我要投诉他！
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Courier attitude teruk, nak complaint!
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Courier attitude teruk, nak complaint!

language_layer.source_text_zh: 快递显示已经签收，但我什么都没收到！
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Tracking show delivered tapi sy x dpt apa!
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Tracking show delivered tapi saya tak dapat apa!

language_layer.source_text_zh: 我的物流一直没更新，都好几天了！
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Tracking sy x update lg! Dah berapa hari.
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Tracking saya tak update lagi! Dah berapa hari.

language_layer.source_text_zh: 等了好几天了，快递还没发货！
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Dah tunggu berapa hari, parcel x pos lagi!
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Dah tunggu berapa hari, parcel tak pos lagi!

language_layer.source_text_zh: 快递送到错误的地址了，怎么处理？
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Parcel hantar salah address, camne settle?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Parcel hantar salah address, macam mana settle?

language_layer.source_text_zh: 收到的东西是坏的，包装都碎了！
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Barang yg dpt rosak, box hancur!
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Barang yang dapat rosak, box hancur!

language_layer.source_text_zh: 快递员态度很差，说话很不好听！
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Courier attitude teruk, sangat x baik!
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Courier attitude teruk, sangat tak baik!

language_layer.source_text_zh: 我的快递好像丢了，怎么办？
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Parcel sy mcm hilang, camne?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Parcel saya macam hilang, macam mana?
